args.message:
FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN for banker's rounding in round_money

round_money quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring (and
FIN-212) specifying banker's rounding. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
half-values round to the nearest even cent, matching
tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: FIN-212: implement banker's rounding in round_money
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` quantized with `ROUND_HALF_UP` — despite its docstring claiming `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Fix
Switched `round_money` to quantize with `decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so half-cents round to the nearest even cent:
- `2.675` → `2.68`
- `2.665` → `2.66`

## Testing
CI passed on `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` (run `ci-0001`).
